title: Typhoon 2: A Family of Open Text and Multimodal Thai Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating a safety classifier's F1 score on a newly curated Thai Sensitive Topic Test Set to measure the model's ability to detect culturally sensitive, inappropriate, or harmful content specific to Thai society.

Measuring the safety classifier's F1 score on the WildGuard benchmark and SafeRLHF test set, which include specific categories for detecting social stereotypes, hate speech, and discriminatory language.

Comparing generation quality and understanding metrics (e.g., Word Error Rate, Character Error Rate, and LLM-as-a-judge scores) across English and Thai language tasks to quantify performance disparities and degradation in the lower-resource language.
